meta.title: Counter Offers: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer in the same tenant, then compare whether Counter Offers are refused or available.
Counter Offer non-commercial terms according to the selected template; the catalog only supports entering a counter price and remark.

steps.note: Create an RFQ event to provide a controlled event for the permission comparison.
Give the event a title required for publishing and later identification.
Configure the event with the RFQ stage required for commercial bidding and counter offers.
Apply an RFQ template so the pricing sheet and its terms are available.
Add a product so a vendor can submit a bid.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before scheduling and publishing.
Commit a bidding schedule required before publishing.
Invite a vendor whose bid will be used for the counter-offer context.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Have the invited vendor submit a bid that can be countered.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer comparison view where Counter Offer is available for an eligible vendor bid.

args.need: sign in as the user without the Buyer role and as the Buyer in the same tenant, attempt Counter Offers on the template's commercial and non-commercial terms, and record whether each attempt is refused or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot authenticate separate roles or exercise the full template-specific non-commercial counter-offer flow.
Assert that the prepared bid comparison screen exposes the known Counter Offer context after the tester's role checks.
